history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Freeze / Unfreeze details.
features: Freeze / Unfreeze Function allows the user to update the status of Port Release to Freeze and Un-Freeze.

events.description: Opens the Freeze / Unfreeze (PR Number) popup asking "Do you want to Freeze the PR request?" or "Do you want to Unfreeze the PR request?" with a remark box
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Freeze / Unfreeze from the single function menu

events.description: Freezes the PR and the Freeze column changes to Freeze. Message: "Port release freezed successfully"
events.triggered_when: Freeze column is No; user enters a valid remark and clicks Ok

events.description: Unfreezes the PR and the Freeze column changes to No. Message: "Port release unfreezed successfully"
events.triggered_when: Freeze column is Freeze; user enters a valid remark and clicks Ok

events.description: Closes the popup without changing the PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks Cancel on the popup

search.name: Remark
search.ui: Mandatory. The user types a valid remark for freezing or unfreezing the PR
